sn55.53:1.1: ekaṃ samayaṃ bhagavā bārāṇasiyaṃ viharati isipatane migadāye.
sn55.53:1.2: atha kho dhammadinno upāsako pañcahi upāsakasatehi saddhiṃ yena bhagavā tenupasaṅkami upasaṅkamitvā bhagavantaṃ abhivādetvā ekamantaṃ nisīdi. ekamantaṃ nisinno kho dhammadinno upāsako bhagavantaṃ etadavoca
sn55.53:1.4: anusāsatu no bhante bhagavā yaṃ amhākaṃ assa dīgharattaṃ hitāya sukhāyāti.
sn55.53:2.1: tasmā tiha vo dhammadinna evaṃ sikkhitabbaṃ
sn55.53:2.2: ye te suttantā tathāgatabhāsitā gambhīrā gambhīratthā lokuttarā suññatapaṭisaṃyuttā te kālena kālaṃ upasampajja viharissāmāti.
sn55.53:2.4: na kho netaṃ bhante sukaraṃ amhehi puttasambādhasayanaṃ ajjhāvasantehi kāsikacandanaṃ paccanubhontehi mālāgandhavilepanaṃ dhārayantehi jātarūparajataṃ sādiyantehi
sn55.53:2.5: ye suttantā tathāgatabhāsitā gambhīrā gambhīratthā lokuttarā suññatapaṭisaṃyuttā te kālena kālaṃ upasampajja viharituṃ
sn55.53:2.6: tesanno bhante bhagavā amhākaṃ pañcasu sikkhāpadesu ṭhitānaṃ uttariṃ dhammaṃ desetūti.
sn55.53:3.1: tasmā tiha vo dhammadinna evaṃ sikkhitabbaṃ
sn55.53:3.3: itipi so bhagavā …pe… satthā devamanussānaṃ buddho bhagavāti.
sn55.53:3.6: ariyakantehi sīlehi samannāgatā bhavissāma akkhaṇḍehi …pe… samādhisaṃvattanikehīti.
sn55.53:4.1: yānīmāni bhante bhagavatā cattāri sotāpattiyaṅgāni desitāni saṃvijjanti te dhammā amhesu mayaṃ ca tesu dhammesu sandissāma.
sn55.53:4.3: itipi so bhagavā …pe… satthā devamanussānaṃ buddho bhagavāti.
sn55.53:4.6: ariyakantehi sīlehi samannāgatā bhavissāma akkhaṇḍehi …pe… samādhisaṃvattanikehīti.
sn55.53:4.7: lābhā vo dhammadinna suladdhaṃ vo dhammadinna
